What Orvael does

Ask. Build. Launch.

01

Chat naturally

Ask in plain words, by typing or by voice. Get a clear, direct answer.

02

Build and preview

Ask for a page or a small tool and see it working right next to the chat.

03

Rooms

3D Studio

Model, sculpt and animate in your browser, or tell Orvael what to build.

01 · Chat

Ask anything. Type it or say it.

One clean place to ask, think and get things done. Start in one tap.

  • Tap the orb to talk. Use your voice instead of the keyboard.
  • Faster or Smarter. Quick replies, or more thinking for harder questions.
  • Sign in with Google, or continue as a guest. No password to remember.
02 · Build

Build it. See it. Change it.

Ask for code, a web page or a small tool. Long code and visual results open in a side panel.

  • Code and Preview side by side, so you see it work at once.
  • Copy or Download the result when you are happy with it.
  • Ask for a change, press Revise, and Orvael updates it.
03 · Your way

You choose how it answers.

Switch things on for a message, when you need them.

  • Straight talk. Honest feedback with no flattery.
  • Web search. Looks things up only when a question needs it.
  • Think deeper and Visual answers for harder questions, diagrams and small interactive tools.
Rooms

Group chat, with Orvael in the room.

Make a room and send the link. Friends join with just a name, no account. Up to 12 people.

Make a room, or join with a code. One tap and you are in.

Start with a game, or just talk. Trivia, trip plans, debates and friendly roasts.

Free games with slash commands. Try /roll and /joke, or type /help.

Say @Orvael to ask it something. Start a line with // to chat without it.

Studio

A 3D studio, right in your browser.

Layout, modeling, sculpting, UV editing, shading, animation and rendering. Import your own .glb, .gltf, .obj or .stl file, or describe what you want and press Build.

Build a spacecraft in one click. This rocket was made from 25 connected parts.

Real tools. Move, rotate and scale, plus physics, cloth, fluid, smoke and more.

Easy to start. Quick guide, keyboard shortcuts, and Build with AI.

Free.
Price

Free to use. Any time.

  • No subscriptionNothing to renew, nothing to cancel.
  • No cardYou never enter payment details to use Orvael.
  • Any timeOpen it whenever you want, on any device.

Fair-use limits keep Orvael fast for everyone.

Why is it free? Orvael is a separate product built by Vaelon Space. It runs as a for-profit project, not as part of our non-profit work, and we are keeping it free to use. We manage the whole AI server ourselves, which is hard and costly, so we use fair-use limits.

Open now

Orvael is open to everyone.

Come in and try it today at orvael.vaelon.space. Share it with your friends and family too.
